detail.longDescription: I built Sidelong because I wanted one single place to store, search, and summarize all the stuff I was reading, watching, and listening to. Save any link, article, podcast, youtube video, local file, or a bunch of other content types. Sidelong presents and embed the content, summarizes the top insights. You can subscribe to newsletters and get them sent and ingested directly, and follow your favorite podcasts and youtube channels to have the new episodes ready for you automatically. Highlight or take notes on what was interesting in anything above right in the app. Sidelong takes what you learn, and gives you a daily summary that connects dots across the sources you saved. It also learns about your interests and recommends what you might want to check out next. If you ever wanted to write about the stuff you're learning, you can use the built in editor which connects what you are writing with all the things you saved and presents it to you while you right. Alot of other features like MCP, AI chat, etc as well.
